style_prompt: Architectural diagram. Hand-drawn line work, two-tone navy and rust on warm cream paper. Crisp legible labels in French. No photo realism, no people, no logos.
image_prompt: A clean editorial before-and-after diagram of one government application, split left to right with a large rust arrow across the middle. LEFT HALF, labelled "SYSTÈME HÉRITÉ": a boxy 1990s beige desktop computer showing a plain text terminal screen, with a paper form and a sealed mailing envelope beside it. RIGHT HALF, labelled "SYSTÈME MODERNE": the same application reborn as a clean modern web portal on a slim laptop, with a small PDF document and an upward upload arrow beside it for direct document submission. Background across the top: a quiet rural scene with a small farmhouse and a propane tank, set far from a thin natural gas pipeline running along the horizon. Include ONLY these exact text labels, each spelled exactly and large enough to be perfectly legible: "SYSTÈME HÉRITÉ", "SYSTÈME MODERNE", and the application title "Application d’allocation de chauffage en région éloignée" shown once on each side. Do NOT add any other words, field labels, menu items, or body text anywhere; leave all form fields and screen lines as blank ruled lines or empty boxes so there is no risk of misspelled or garbled text. Muted Alberta cream base with deep navy line work and small rust accents, archival print quality, no logos. All text labels in Canadian French. Match the composition of the source image exactly; only the text labels change.
